_note: Placeholder data shown before live data arrives, and used for the README screenshots.

hotkey.hint: Hold to talk. A tap under 300 ms cancels silently.

microphone.hint: Bluetooth headsets drop to the narrowband hands-free profile when the mic opens.

languages.hint: Parakeet auto-detects between the enabled languages. Fewer languages does not make it faster.

cleanup.hint: Cleanup is an enhancement, never a dependency. On timeout the raw transcript is pasted instead.

fillers.hint: Drops "um", "uh", "like" and their German and Greek equivalents.

autostart.hint: Registered under the Windows Run key, verified by read-back.

startMinimised.hint: Starts in the tray with no window.

closeToTray.hint: Closing the window destroys it; Flowstate keeps running in the tray.

model.name: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3
model.unloadHint: 0 keeps the model resident. Unloading frees about 700 MB and costs one cold load.

recentErrors.message: llm: provider timed out after 2500 ms — pasted the raw transcript
inject: target window was elevated — text left on the clipboard

about.diagnosticsHint: Copies versions, paths and the last errors. Never the API key.
